description: Feature set R. R_U = unit|contract with non-empty tests. R_manual = R \ R_U. ui:true requires design gate.

requirements.title: Detect exploitable loopback MCP-like HTTP surfaces
requirements.acceptance: Flags cors_star / no_www_authenticate_hint / known ports from fixtures; bare TCP is not exposure

requirements.title: Enumerate loopback/unspecified TCP listeners instead of port whitelist
requirements.acceptance: discover_listeners merges live LISTEN ports; bind-addr filter is loopback|unspecified; extras from scan.ports still probed

requirements.title: Probe tools/list; warn only on unprotected MCP surfaces
requirements.acceptance: No risk for plain HTTP; mcp_jsonrpc_surface / mcp_tools_exposed only when unauthenticated MCP probe succeeds; 401/403 not scored; parse SSE/JSON fixtures

requirements.title: Probe real loopback ports when services are up
requirements.acceptance: With WorkBuddy (or moved MCP port) listening, enumerate scan reports the live port and exposure when CORS/auth/MCP heuristics hit

requirements.title: Attribute TCP peers on watched ports to PID/process
requirements.acceptance: Allowlist matching is pure; unknown_client classification from fixtures

requirements.title: Observe real connections to MCP ports
requirements.acceptance: Browser/PoC hitting 50551 shows activity_alert for non-allowlisted process

requirements.title: Persist alerts and scan/watch events as JSONL
requirements.acceptance: append writes valid JSON lines; creates parent dirs

requirements.title: Resident loop: scan + watch + audit on interval
requirements.acceptance: serve --once emits scan and watch; cancel flag stops loop promptly

requirements.title: Raise EXPOSURE ALERT when risk_flags non-empty
requirements.acceptance: Given a ScanReport with risk_flags, audit kind exposure_alert is written

requirements.title: Raise ACTIVITY ALERT on unknown clients
requirements.acceptance: Given WatchReport.alert_count>0, audit kind activity_alert is written

requirements.title: Hard-block unknown clients on watched ports
requirements.acceptance: PoC page cannot complete exfil while gate enabled (OS-specific)

requirements.title: Load mcp-guard.toml with scan/gate/serve/audit sections
requirements.acceptance: Missing file → defaults; invalid TOML → error

requirements.title: System tray agent: status, alerts, open audit
requirements.acceptance: Native tray reflects alerts; Open audit / Scan / Mute / Quit work on host OS

requirements.title: Main dashboard window: status, metrics, actions, feedback
requirements.acceptance: Open dashboard from tray/CLI; auto-scan once on startup; minimize/close hide to tray and tray restores window; Quit exits; Scan now shows scanning + toast + result strip

requirements.title: Derive alert snapshot from audit JSONL
requirements.acceptance: Counts exposure_alert/activity_alert; captures last_scan_at

requirements.title: Tray menu model from status + ui copy
requirements.acceptance: idle/exposure/activity + mute map to labels and ordered actions

requirements.title: Encrypted secret store put/list/delete/resolve locally
requirements.acceptance: Roundtrip encrypt; list has no plaintext; resolve only via local API

requirements.title: MCP vault tools never return plaintext secrets
requirements.acceptance: issue_ref/list/run payloads have no value field; scrubber redacts secret from stdout

requirements.title: stdio MCP server vault-mcp for agents
requirements.acceptance: Cursor mcp.json points at mcp-guard vault-mcp; tools usable; no secret in transcript

requirements.title: Dashboard vault manager: add/list/delete secrets
requirements.acceptance: UI can save secret without re-displaying plaintext; list names only

requirements.title: UI locale packs; default zh-CN for daily debug
requirements.acceptance: Default locale zh-CN; en pack loads; tray/dashboard/toast strings come from catalog; --locale overrides

requirements.title: Scan local git trees for opaque LLM reasoning signatures before they land in history
requirements.acceptance: Detect Anthropic thinking.signature / OpenAI encrypted_content / Gemini thoughtSignature / generic long signature fields in tracked or staged files; exit non-zero with --fail when findings present; fixtures under cases/arxiv-2608-09867

requirements.title: Offense/defense case pack for Stealing Reasoning Traces (arXiv:2608.09867)
requirements.acceptance: cases/arxiv-2608-09867 documents PocketCity past_turn decrypt + defense git-scan/hooks; compare page shows ciphertext vs plaintext
